caption: An athlete throws a hammer, the rotation of the hammer head clearly visible against the sky.
positive_analysis:
The athlete's overhead grip on the hammer shaft, when released, lets the rod and weighted heads spin against the sky.
The extended arm and torso twist supply torque that makes the hammer head rotate visibly around the shaft.
Against the uniform blue sky, the spinning hammer head traces a clear circular path as the throw unfolds.

negative_analysis:
The athlete's rotation causes the hammer to swing in an arc around his body.
The swinging hammer's outward pull is counterbalanced by the athlete's extended free arm.
Acceleration of the hammerhead increases tension in the connecting wire.
The athlete's twisting torso generates rotational momentum for the throw.
